in_sanskrit.name: Brijkishore
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Bridge
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Brijkishore एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Brij means 'Lord' and Kishore means 'Youth' or 'Young Man'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Brihkut' which means 'bridge'. Brij is also a name of a renowned holy city in India, Brindavan, which is known as the 'Lord of the Bridge'. Thus, Brijkishore signifies the one who is the Lord of the Bridge or the protector of the people.
